high_level_description: This image captures a serene scene at what appears to be the edge of an urban area during sunset or sunrise. The sky is a gradient of soft blues and oranges, with scattered clouds adding texture to the backdrop. The sun is low on the horizon, casting a warm glow over the landscape. In the foreground, there are multiple railway tracks running parallel to each other, indicating a busy rail line. To the left, there is a concrete bridge with an arched design, supported by several vertical pillars. The bridge seems to be part of a road or pathway that crosses over the railway tracks.
